title: When a staff member leaves, cash he took without internet and never sent stays on his phone, and nobody is told
what: Payments, plans sold and new members made with no internet wait on the device that made them. When the owner removes a staff member who leaves, that person's phone loses its sign-in, but the waiting payments stay on it and are sent only if someone from the same gym signs in on that very phone again. The owner's Remove box says 'Your members and payments stay as they are', and the removed person's screen only says 'You no longer have access'. Neither says that money taken on that phone has not reached the gym's records, so the receipts are missing from dues and money totals with no warning.
expected: Before removing a person, the owner is told that their device may still hold unsent payments. The removed device's screen says how many payments are still waiting there and to hand the phone to the owner to sign in once so they are sent.
who: owners and desk staff who leave
how_often: whenever a staff member leaves with unsent offline payments on his phone
fix_line: Warn the owner in the Remove box, and show the removed device how many payments still wait there

title: When the owner or a staff member gets a new mobile number, it cannot be changed: the person must be added again
what: Each person on Staff & sign-in is listed with the mobile number they sign in with. The row offers a sign-in code, sign out, the Trainer tick and Remove, but nothing to change the number. A staff member with a new number must be removed and added again, which loses the Trainer tick and the job name and signs them out. An owner cannot remove his own row, so he must add himself again as a second owner with the new number, sign in with it, then remove the old row. Nothing on the screen says so.
expected: The owner can change a person's mobile number (his own too) on the person's row, after checking the new number.
who: owners and desk staff who change their number
how_often: each time someone changes their mobile number
fix_line: Add a Change number step on each person's row

title: The list of times MettleUp support looked at the gym shows a day and month but no year
what: The MettleUp access card lists every time support looked at the gym's records, with dates like '23 Oct, 14:05-14:35'. After the first year the owner cannot tell a visit from last October from one this October, on a record that exists to show the owner exactly when MettleUp looked.
expected: Dates older than this year show the year too.
fix_line: Add the year to these dates when it is not this year

title: If a terms change reaches the admin app before the server, every owner is stopped at the terms page and no new gym can be made
what: When the MettleUp terms change, the admin app asks every owner to accept the new date before going on, and Create my gym sends that date too. The server refuses any date it does not have in its own list, or any date later than today in India. The order (server first, admin app after) is only written in a code note, and the build's check looks at the files in the code, not the live server. If the admin app is uploaded first, or the date is set ahead of the day, every owner who opens the panel gets an error on 'Agree and continue' and can only sign out, and Create my gym fails for every new gym, until the server is updated.
expected: If the server does not know the terms date yet, the owner is let in and asked again later; and the upload step checks the live server's list before the admin app goes out.
how_often: only when a terms change is uploaded in the wrong order or dated ahead
fix_line: Let the owner in when the server does not know the date yet, and check the live list before upload

items.reason: Web panel: no install package, sideload, Play package or watch/phone version split in this area. Data kept across updates: the browser-only gym has a shape number and backs up (never overwrites) a copy it cannot read; missing collections from older saves are filled in; the offline copy is fetched again when its shape differs; the old step-2 check-ins are moved to the waiting list once; job names kept on a browser before the server had them are sent and forgotten once it does. The waiting list has shape 1 and a different number would empty it (outbox.ts:119), so a future shape change will need a move, not a reset: no change yet, so no finding. Old owner key after going online: FN-B-run-panel-auth-data-b-01.

Trial and plan end screens live in ui-shell (checked there); here a paused or lapsed gym tells desk staff to download data only owners can: FN-L14-panel-auth-data-01; a new trial by re-making the gym: FN-L19-panel-auth-data-01. Staff leaves: removed device keeps the offline copy (FN-B-time-panel-ui-shell-01) and waiting items (FN-L4-panel-auth-data-04); cash taken offline on that phone silently never reaches the records: FN-B-time-panel-auth-data-01 (new); removed person's details kept for ever: FN-L4-panel-auth-data-05. Year end: support visit list has no year: FN-B-time-panel-auth-data-03 (new). Leap day: no date arithmetic in this area (codes and PIN locks are minutes). Six months unopened: the sign-in never runs out (FN-L3-panel-auth-data-01) and refused offline items are resent after 30 days (FN-L5-panel-auth-data-03). Member leaves and returns: handled in the logic and screens areas, not here.

Job names (R-522) can only be typed when a person is ADDED, so everyone added before it has no way to get one: FN-A5-panel-auth-data-2-02 (reused). The set-your-PIN prompt shows only after a new code sign-in, but existing people can set a PIN on the You card. New terms: existing owners are asked once by the terms page. Browser-only gyms and old owner keys have the Put your records online card.
Paths exist for PINs (You card), terms (asked on next open) and going online (Settings card). No path for a job name on someone already on the list: only remove and add again.
Rule applied: the one flow with no path for existing people is already a finding (reused, not repeated).

The only 'new' mark here is the dot beside Staff & sign-in, built by the shared dot rule that skips features older than the gym's set-up day. A brand-new gym accepts the current terms when it is made, so it never sees the 'We updated the terms' words; those show only to owners who accepted an older version.

Rule applied: no mark in this area shows a brand-new gym or person something as new that is not new to them (the gym-wide cases are in ui-shell: FN-B-time-panel-logic-1-04, FN-B-time-panel-logic-1-02).
